This block sits in the last 3.9 weeks before the qualifier, so it is a peak/arrival phase, not a build. Weeks 1-2 keep the lifts frequent and specific, Week 3 drops fatigue with the loads largely intact, and Week 4 is competition week built to leave you sharp for Day 0.

Week 2 nudges the main-lift singles up while the squat, pull, row and trunk support mostly hold. Week 3 keeps similar loads but trims singles and support sets. Week 4 is a descending competition week: one technical touch per day, very little generic work, and the Day -1 primer is optional.

Do your usual wrist prep before every rack day. If the left wrist rises above mild awareness, or the front rack starts changing your dip/drive or receiving position, hold the listed load, cut the last planned single or set, and use the lighter earlier-week exposure rather than forcing a heavier rack.

Mon	Snatch	98 kg	6	1	3 min	8	88% of 112; heavy crisp singles; if a catch softens or RPE goes past 8.5, stay here and stop at 5 total.	
Mon	Front Squat	132 kg	3	2	3 min	7.5	80% of 165; keep 2 RIR; if rack discomfort rises, do 2 sets only.	
Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	3	8	90 sec	8	Upper-back balance without extra axial fatigue.	
Mon	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	30 sec/side	30 sec	6	Easy trunk stiffness.

Tue	Clean and jerk	124 kg	5	1	3-4 min	8	88% of 141; heavy but clean; if rack or jerk timing slips, stay at 120-122 and finish crisp.	
Tue	Barbell Row	120 kg	3	2	2-3 min	7	Below your current 130 x 3 snatch-specific pulling benchmark; use snatch grip and an explosive finish, stop at 2 sets if speed drops.

TAPER AUDIT
Event: strength meet, priority A, about 3.9 weeks out.
This block runs into the event: the final week is competition week.

WEEK PHASES: 1=realization 2=realization 3=taper 4=competition_week EVENT=strength_meet

    phase             sets  exercises  competition lift  power sets  peak RPE  peak % max
W1  realization       63    10         41%               26          8         88%
W2  realization       63    10         41%               26          8.5       90%
W3  taper             46    9          41%               31          8         90%
W4  competition week  29    7          21%               22          7.5       88%

Across the block: volume -34 sets, exercises -3, competition-lift share -20 points, peak effort -0.5 RPE, accessory volume -22 sets.
